INFJ>INTJ.title: You think about people's feelings when you make plans.
INFJ>INTJ.body: When you make a plan, along with "Will this work?" you also think, "Will anyone have a bad time?" Even when choosing where to go on a trip, you put the costs and travel times in a chart and also check whether anyone tires easily. You think it through with logic, then also consider how others will feel, so people around you rely on you.
INFJ>INTJ.say: "It makes sense. Now it's just how they'll take it."
INFJ>INTJ.do: Before starting a new hobby, you look up how to do it on your own first.
INFJ>INTJ.worry: You know what you want to say, but you spend so long on how to say it that you speak up late. On days you were blunt, you keep wondering until night what the other person thought.
INFJ>INTJ.karai: Next year is all planned out, but you still haven't answered about tomorrow's drinks.
INFJ>INTJ.karai_s: Next year is all planned out, but you still haven't answered about hanging out tomorrow.
INFJ>INTJ.aru: In a meeting you start to say "Isn't that a waste of time?", see their face, and stop. On the way home, you think, "I should have just said it."
INFJ>INTJ.aru_s: While planning a group presentation, you start to say "Isn't that a waste of time?", see their face, and stop. On the way home, you think, "I should have just said it."
INFJ>INTJ.why: By birth, you're the type who decides with your feelings. As you gained experience, you became able to spot "what's wasteful" with logic. Still, thinking first about how the other person will feel is still strongly there. Even when you notice something is a waste and start to say it, seeing their face makes your wish not to hurt them win out, so you swallow your words and regret it afterward.
INFJ>INTJ.yure: The only difference between your temperament and your character is whether you decide with logic or with feelings. Picture yourself at work and you lean toward logic. Picture a friend asking for advice and you lean toward feelings, so your result can change.
INFJ>INTJ.yure_s: The only difference between your temperament and your character is whether you decide with logic or with feelings. Picture yourself working on an assignment or group presentation and you lean toward logic. Picture a friend asking for advice and you lean toward feelings, so your result can change.
INFJ>INTJ.plus: You take time choosing your words because you don't want to hurt anyone. You think before you speak, so people are willing to listen to you.
INFJ>INTJ.tip: For hard things, decide ahead of time to say the main point first. You can add the kind words after that.
INFJ>INTJ.hidden: People often see you as logical, but you were born good at noticing how people feel. When a coworker's reply is shorter than usual, don't you wonder if something's up? If you ask "Are you okay?" right then, people will find you easy to talk to.
INFJ>INTJ.hidden_s: People often see you as logical, but you were born good at noticing how people feel. When a classmate's reply is shorter than usual, don't you wonder if something's up? If you ask "Are you okay?" right then, people will find you easy to talk to.

INFJ>INTP.title: You listen, and then you can't help asking "why?"
INFJ>INTP.body: While listening to a friend's problem, before you know it you're thinking, "How did this even happen in the first place?" Even when watching the news, the reason it happened interests you more than what happened, so you end up looking into it. You value people's feelings, but you also like thinking things through with logic. Some days you stick to the plan, and some days you change your mind on the spot.
INFJ>INTP.say: "I want to think it over alone. Can I get back to you tomorrow?"
INFJ>INTP.do: You start looking something up before bed, and suddenly two hours have passed.
INFJ>INTP.worry: You want to help people, but thinking gets so fun that you stop actually doing anything. Right after you make a plan, you think of a better way and start over.
INFJ>INTP.karai: At the party you just listen, then think over the whole talk on the train home.
INFJ>INTP.karai_s: When everyone hangs out, you just listen, then think over the whole talk on the train home.
INFJ>INTP.aru: You were listening to a friend's problem, and suddenly you're asking "But why?" and looking for the cause. Later you realize, "Maybe they just wanted me to listen."
INFJ>INTP.why: By birth, you're the type who decides with your feelings and wants things to go as planned. Through all kinds of experiences, you became able to think with logic and change your mind on the spot. Your ability to pick up on how others feel is still as it was when you were born. Wanting to find the cause while you listen is a thinking habit you have now, and a little later you notice the other person's feelings and rethink: "Maybe they just wanted me to listen."
INFJ>INTP.yure: The two differences are logic or feelings, and whether you stick to a plan or go with the flow. Picture yourself helping a friend or picture yourself deep in research, and your result can change.
INFJ>INTP.plus: You think so hard you stop moving because you don't want to give a careless answer. The ideas you take time to reach really do help people.
INFJ>INTP.tip: When someone comes to you, first ask, "Do you want me to just listen, or think it through together?" Then you can give them what they need.
INFJ>INTP.hidden: You like letting your thoughts wander, but you were also born good at getting ready properly. The day before something important, don't you find yourself checking what to bring and what time to leave? Use that, and you'll see your ideas through to the end.

INFJ>ENTJ.title: Put you in charge, and things get decided fast.
INFJ>ENTJ.body: After you set it, "The deadline is Friday," you go over to check on anyone who seems tired. In meetings, you start by writing down three things to decide that day and finish on time. You're good at standing in front of people and making decisions, but you also need time to think slowly on your own.
INFJ>ENTJ.say: "Friday it is. If you think you can't make it, tell me early."
INFJ>ENTJ.do: When you set the schedule, you think "they're good at this" and split up the jobs that way.
INFJ>ENTJ.worry: The more you take charge, the less time you have alone. After you say something strict, you worry, "Was that too much?"
INFJ>ENTJ.karai: You make sure everyone gets their days off, but yours is always "sometime."
INFJ>ENTJ.aru: You organize the work dinner and handle everything from picking the place to splitting the bill. But on the train home you're worn out and don't want to talk to anyone.
INFJ>ENTJ.aru_s: You organize the class party after an event and handle everything from picking the place to splitting the bill. But on the train home you're worn out and don't want to talk to anyone.
INFJ>ENTJ.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone and decides with your feelings. Through dealing with all kinds of people, you became able to stand in front of people and decide firmly with logic. Still, the energy you use only comes back with quiet time alone, even now. While you're organizing, you keep using up energy among people, so on the train home, you have no energy left to talk to anyone.
INFJ>ENTJ.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and logic or feelings. Picture yourself leading a group or picture your day off, and your result can change.
INFJ>ENTJ.plus: You're worn out on the way home because you were looking out for everyone. When someone organizes things and also cares about people, everyone can relax and have fun.
INFJ>ENTJ.tip: Keep the day after you organize something free. On the day itself, it also helps to hand one job, like the bill, to someone else.
INFJ>ENTJ.tip_s: Keep the day after you lead something free. On the day itself, it also helps to hand one job, like the bill, to someone else.
INFJ>ENTJ.hidden: You decide fast, so people see you as someone to lean on. But you were also born noticing right away when someone's face clouds over a little. Ask "Are you okay?" then, and people will find it easier to talk too.

INFJ>ENTP.title: Once you start talking with people, the ideas don't stop.
INFJ>ENTP.body: When everyone's talking, ideas keep coming to you: "Then what if we did it this way?" You build on other people's ideas too, "It'd be more fun if we changed this part," and keep the conversation growing. But when you get home, you worry whether anyone had a bad time. You like talking with people, but you also need time alone.
INFJ>ENTP.say: "Oh, nice! If we do this, it could be even more fun."
INFJ>ENTP.do: After a movie, you think up a different ending: "I'd have done it like this."
INFJ>ENTP.worry: Ideas keep coming when you're with people, but when you get home you're suddenly exhausted. Some days you want to act on a whim and some days you want a real plan, and you can't decide.
INFJ>ENTP.karai: When the talk turns to "what if we won the lottery," you suddenly get the most fired up.
INFJ>ENTP.aru: You're chatting with friends and get excited: "Let's do it!" But when you get home, you remember what you said and wonder, "Did I go too far?"
INFJ>ENTP.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone, decides with your feelings, and wants things to go as planned. As the years went by, you became able to expand your ideas by talking with people, poke at things with logic, and go with the moment. Your wish not to hurt people is still as it was when you were born. While you're talking, you're absorbed in expanding ideas, but once you're alone and calm, the other person's face comes to mind, and you look back and think, "Did I go too far?"
INFJ>ENTP.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture a day chatting with friends or picture yourself home alone, and getting a different type wouldn't be strange.
INFJ>ENTP.plus: You look back later because you were thinking about the other person even while having fun. Even when things get lively, you keep the other person in mind, so people feel at ease with you.
INFJ>ENTP.tip: When you start going over the day, remember the most fun moment first, then go to sleep. Ending on a good feeling makes you want to see people again.
INFJ>ENTP.hidden: You often go with the mood, but you were also born good at making plans and following them. Before a trip, haven't you found you've already checked the train times and when the shops open? Use that, and the things you get excited about will actually happen.

INFJ>INFJ.title: You notice right away when a friend seems down.
INFJ>INFJ.body: You quickly notice small changes in people. When someone sighs at work, you can't help stopping what you're doing to see how they are. On your way home that day, you send a short message: "Did something happen?"
INFJ>INFJ.body_s: You quickly notice small changes in people. When someone sighs in class, you can't help stopping what you're doing to see how they are. After school that day, you send a short message: "Did something happen?"
INFJ>INFJ.say: "Don't push yourself. I'm always here to listen."
INFJ>INFJ.do: You remember a dream a friend once mentioned, and when you find an article that fits, you quietly send it to them.
INFJ>INFJ.worry: While you go along with everyone, you stop saying what you want to do. When something you hoped for doesn't work out, some days you feel down on your own.
INFJ>INFJ.karai: You'll help with a friend's problem until midnight, but you don't notice that you're tired.
INFJ>INFJ.aru: When a friend says "I'm fine," you can hear in their voice that they're not. You keep thinking about them for the rest of the day.
INFJ>INFJ.why: Your temperament and character are the same combination in all four letters. Noticing small changes in people's voices and faces and thinking about what they mean has carried on just as it is since you were a kid. Not being able to forget what you notice right away is the same too. You can tell from a single tone of voice that someone is "not okay," so that person stays on your mind for the rest of the day.
INFJ>INFJ.yure: You'll likely get almost the same result every time. If a different type shows up, you may be in a stretch of listening to a lot of people and feeling worn out.
INFJ>INFJ.plus: You notice small changes because you really watch the people around you. There are people near you who feel, "They get me."
INFJ>INFJ.tip: On nights when someone stays on your mind, take 30 minutes for yourself, like a bath or a favorite video, before bed. It helps your mind switch off so you can rest.
INFJ>INFJ.hidden: You like things to go as planned, but you can also enjoy going with the flow. Has a shop you wandered into on a day off ever turned out to be more fun than you expected? Leave a day unplanned now and then, and you'll feel lighter.

INFJ>INFP.title: Books and songs move you easily.
INFJ>INFP.body: When you hear about a friend's hard times, your heart hurts as if it were your own. You listen to the lyrics of a favorite song again and again, matching them to how you feel at the time. You like making plans, but some days you want to change them based on your mood that day.
INFJ>INFP.say: "These lyrics feel like they're about me. They made me cry."
INFJ>INFP.do: You buy a novel at the bookstore because the cover caught your eye, and finish it alone that night.
INFJ>INFP.worry: When you can't stick to a plan, you think, "I'm no good." But when you pack your schedule, that feels hard too.
INFJ>INFP.karai: After saying no to plans, you worry "Did that sound rude?" until bedtime.
INFJ>INFP.aru: At New Year's you decided to "do yoga every morning," but by day three it's "A walk is fine today." You didn't quit, but you still feel a little bad about it.
INFJ>INFP.why: By birth, you're the type who wants things to go as planned. As you gained experience, you also learned to act according to your mood that day. Your wish to follow through on what you decide is still there. Now that you can change plans by mood, you also clearly see yourself not doing what you decided, so even though you didn't quit, you blame yourself.
INFJ>INFP.yure: The only difference is whether you stick to a plan or go with the flow. Picture a work deadline and you lean toward planning. Picture your day off and you lean toward going with the flow.
INFJ>INFP.yure_s: The only difference is whether you stick to a plan or go with the flow. Picture a homework deadline and you lean toward planning. Picture your day off and you lean toward going with the flow.
INFJ>INFP.plus: If you keep going even when you change the plan, you've found a way that fits you. Little by little, you're moving forward.
INFJ>INFP.tip: Instead of deciding on "yoga," try something looser like "move my body in the morning." You can pick what to do based on your mood, so you'll have more days you did it.
INFJ>INFP.hidden: You often change plans based on your mood, but you were born good at thinking ahead and getting things in order. On trips with friends, don't you somehow end up the one who sets the meeting time and picks the trains? Use that, and people at work will feel safe leaving things to you.
INFJ>INFP.hidden_s: You often change plans based on your mood, but you were born good at thinking ahead and getting things in order. On trips with friends, don't you somehow end up the one who sets the meeting time and picks the trains? Use that, and people will feel safe leaving group projects to you too.

INFJ>ENFJ.title: When people get together, you end up in charge.
INFJ>ENFJ.body: At get-togethers you bring everyone together, and at home you rest quietly alone. When someone hasn't joined the conversation, you casually bring them in: "What do you think?" You're good at being active in front of people, but you need time alone to rest just as much.
INFJ>ENFJ.say: "I reached out to the people who haven't been coming lately, too."
INFJ>ENFJ.do: You remember what your juniors are good at, and when a job that fits comes up, you let them know.
INFJ>ENFJ.do_s: You remember what younger members are good at, and when a role that fits them comes up, you let them know.
INFJ>ENFJ.worry: While you're busy helping people, you look up and have no time to yourself. You're glad to be relied on, but sometimes you want to be left alone.
INFJ>ENFJ.karai: Your trip plan has everyone's must-see spots except yours.
INFJ>ENFJ.aru: At get-togethers with friends, you're naturally the one getting everyone talking. But on the way home, you turn off your phone notifications and don't want to talk to anyone.
INFJ>ENFJ.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone. Through all kinds of experiences, you became able to bring everyone together and get things moving among people too. Still, the place where you can get back the energy you used is time alone, even now. At get-togethers you look out for everyone and use up all your energy, so on the way home, you want to turn off your notifications and have time without talking to anyone.
INFJ>ENFJ.yure: The only difference is whether people energize you or you recharge alone. Picture yourself getting everyone talking or picture yourself on the way home, and your result can change.
INFJ>ENFJ.plus: You don't want to talk afterward because you really showed up for everyone. You get everyone talking, so people want to come again.
INFJ>ENFJ.tip: Keep the evening after a get-together free, with no plans. Knowing you have time to rest lets you look forward to the day itself.
INFJ>ENFJ.hidden: You're good at leading groups, but you were also born good at thinking things over alone. Don't you sometimes realize later, "Oh, maybe that's what they meant," about something a friend said in passing? Use that, and you'll understand how people feel even better.

INFJ>ENFP.title: You hit it off quickly, even with people you just met.
INFJ>ENFP.body: You hit it off right away even with people you've just met, while still noticing the feelings they don't say out loud. As you talk, you find topics that make the other person light up and build on them. Some days you get bright among people, and some days you want to be quiet on your own.
INFJ>ENFP.say: "Ooh, I like that! Tell me more."
INFJ>ENFP.do: You hit it off with someone you just met and swap contact info right there.
INFJ>ENFP.worry: The more fun the day, the more tired you are that night. The things you want to do keep piling up, and it feels like you're only halfway on all of them.
INFJ>ENFP.karai: While listening to a friend's crush story, you're already picturing their wedding.
INFJ>ENFP.aru: When someone invites you, you say "I'm in!" right away. But on the morning of, you're in bed thinking, "Maybe I don't want to go after all."
INFJ>ENFP.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone and wants things to go as planned. Through dealing with all kinds of people, you started getting energy from being with others too, and you also learned to act on a whim. When someone invites you, the excited feeling comes forward right away, but where you store up energy is still time alone. On the morning of the day, the energy you'll use among people suddenly feels heavy, and you go back and forth in bed.
INFJ>ENFP.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and whether you stick to a plan or go with the flow. Picture yourself having fun with friends or picture a quiet night alone, and your result can change.
INFJ>ENFP.plus: You hesitate in the morning because if you go, you want to really enjoy it. The more time you take to rest, the brighter you can be when you see people.
INFJ>ENFP.tip: When you reply to an invite, try adding when you'll leave, like "I can stay until 9." Knowing when you'll head home makes that morning easier.
INFJ>ENFP.hidden: You often act on a whim, but you were born good at making plans and sticking with them. When you start a new hobby, don't you get the gear and decide "every Saturday"? Use that, and you'll keep going with the things you want to do.

INFJ>ISTJ.title: Your work is precise, and you're kind when you teach.
INFJ>ISTJ.title_s: You're precise with your tasks, and kind when you teach.
INFJ>ISTJ.body: You do your work strictly by the steps, but when someone's having trouble, you can't help stopping to listen to them. That's why people say, "It's reassuring to leave it to you." For newcomers, you hand them a note of the steps you made yourself and go over the parts they don't understand together.
INFJ>ISTJ.body_s: You do assignments and class jobs strictly by the steps, but when someone's having trouble, you can't help stopping to listen to them. That's why people say, "It's reassuring to leave it to you." For a classmate doing a class job for the first time, you hand them a note of the steps you made yourself and go over it together.
INFJ>ISTJ.say: "The steps look good. I'll just add one thing here."
INFJ>ISTJ.do: After teaching a new hire, you always add, "Ask me anytime."
INFJ>ISTJ.do_s: After showing a new club member how things work, you always add, "Ask me anytime."
INFJ>ISTJ.worry: You want to follow the rules, but once you hear someone's situation, you start to waver. Even when you're curious about what's ahead, it's hard to move without solid reasons.
INFJ>ISTJ.karai: A sudden "Can you come now?" gets a no, because you had plans to lie around at home.
INFJ>ISTJ.aru: You mean to say "Sorry, those are the rules," but as you listen to them, you start thinking, "Maybe just this once..."
INFJ>ISTJ.why: By birth, you're the type who imagines what's ahead and decides with your feelings. As you gained experience, you became able to keep to rules and precedent and decide with logic. Being moved by other people's circumstances is something you were born with. Even though you know keeping the rules is right, the more you listen, the more you see their situation, so you start to waver: "Maybe just this once..."
INFJ>ISTJ.yure: The two differences are hunches or facts, and logic or feelings. Picture work steps or picture a friend asking for advice, and your result can change.
INFJ>ISTJ.yure_s: The two differences are hunches or facts, and logic or feelings. Picture the steps for an assignment or club task or picture a friend asking for advice, and your result can change.
INFJ>ISTJ.plus: You waver because you care about both the rules and the person. You think it through before you answer, so people accept your call.
INFJ>ISTJ.tip: When you can't decide on an exception, ask, "Could I do the same for everyone?" If you could, you won't feel uneasy later.
INFJ>ISTJ.hidden: You check the facts and the usual way of doing things, but you were also born good at coming up with new ways. In the middle of routine work, don't you sometimes think, "This would be easier if..."? Say it out loud, and you'll get trusted with new work.
INFJ>ISTJ.hidden_s: You check the facts and the usual way of doing things, but you were also born good at coming up with new ways. In the middle of a routine task, don't you sometimes think, "This would be easier if..."? Say it out loud, and you'll get trusted with new roles.

INFJ>ISFJ.title: You worry, so you always pack a little extra.
INFJ>ISFJ.body: On the day a friend moves, you show up with work gloves and drinks for everyone. You remember what ran short the last time you helped, and this time you bring that too. Everything is ready before anyone else even notices, so people often tell you, "You saved us."
INFJ>ISFJ.body_s: On school festival prep days, you show up with work gloves and drinks for everyone. You remember what ran short during last year's prep, and this year you bring that too. Everything is ready before anyone else even notices, so people often tell you, "You saved us."
INFJ>ISFJ.do: You remember a coworker's birthday and hand them a small snack that morning.
INFJ>ISFJ.do_s: You remember a classmate's birthday and hand them a small snack that morning.
INFJ>ISFJ.worry: Thinking about what might happen makes you worry, and you keep adding to your prep. Getting things ready for others comes first, and what you want to do gets pushed back.
INFJ>ISFJ.karai: Even a one-line text reply gets reread three times before you send it.
INFJ>ISFJ.aru: The day before a family trip, you think "What if it rains?" and "What if someone gets a stomachache?" and only your bag is stuffed. And yet you forgot to pack your own toothbrush.
INFJ>ISFJ.why: By birth, you're the type who imagines what's ahead. As the years went by, you became able to prepare based on what's happened before and what's in front of you. Thinking about people's feelings first has been the same since way back. On top of imagining "this might happen," you add memories of times things went wrong before, so while you're preparing for your whole family, your own things get put off.
INFJ>ISFJ.yure: The only difference is hunches or facts and experience. Picture your future dreams and you lean toward hunches. Picture everyday chores and you lean toward experience.
INFJ>ISFJ.yure_s: The only difference is hunches or facts and experience. Picture your future dreams and you lean toward hunches. Picture your everyday classes and club practice and you lean toward experience.
INFJ>ISFJ.plus: Your bag gets heavy because you don't want the people you love to be stuck. Someone has definitely been helped by how prepared you are.
INFJ>ISFJ.tip: When you pack, put your own wallet, phone, and toothbrush in first. If your things go in first, you won't forget anything.
INFJ>ISFJ.hidden: You take care of what's in front of you, step by step, but you were also born good at noticing the feelings behind words. When someone in your family says "It's fine," don't you sometimes sense they don't really mean it? Ask "What's up?" then, and they'll find you easier to talk to.

INFJ>ESTJ.title: Once you decide something, you see it through.
INFJ>ESTJ.body: When you talk about changing how things are done at work, in your head you're thinking, "So everyone can go home earlier." In meetings, you decide on the spot who does what by when and write it out on the whiteboard. In front of people you briskly tell them "do it this way," but sometimes you worry about how they feel afterward.
INFJ>ESTJ.body_s: When you talk about changing how your club does things, in your head you're thinking, "So everyone can go home earlier." In meetings, you decide on the spot who does what by when and write it out on the whiteboard. In front of people you briskly tell them "do it this way," but sometimes you worry about how they feel afterward.
INFJ>ESTJ.say: "Please keep to the deadline. If you get stuck, tell me early."
INFJ>ESTJ.do: When you hand out tasks, you give lighter work to anyone who looks unwell.
INFJ>ESTJ.do_s: When you split up tasks for the school festival, you give lighter jobs to anyone who looks unwell.
INFJ>ESTJ.worry: The more you lead, the less time you have to think alone. You want to settle what needs doing, but you also care how people feel, and that makes you hesitate.
INFJ>ESTJ.karai: The night before a trip, you can't sleep until everything you're bringing is lined up by the door.
INFJ>ESTJ.aru: At work you say clearly, "Please have this done by this date." That night in the bath, you remember it and think, "Was I cold?" and feel down.
INFJ>ESTJ.aru_s: At a student council meeting you say clearly, "Please have this done by this date." That night in the bath, you remember it and think, "Was I cold?" and feel down.
INFJ>ESTJ.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone, imagines what's ahead, and decides with your feelings. Through dealing with all kinds of people, you became able to act briskly in front of others and move things forward with the facts in front of you and logic. Worrying about the other person's feelings has carried on just as it was when you were born. During the day you put moving things forward first and can say it clearly, but when you're alone at night, you remember their face and feel down, wondering, "Was I cold?"
INFJ>ESTJ.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself leading at work or picture yourself thinking alone, and you might get a different type.
INFJ>ESTJ.yure_s: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself leading in a club or student council or picture yourself thinking alone, and you might get a different type.
INFJ>ESTJ.plus: You worry about how you said it because you really care about the other person. A senior who makes the calls and still thinks about people makes the office feel safe.
INFJ>ESTJ.plus_s: You worry about how you said it because you really care about the other person. An upperclassman who makes the calls and still thinks about people makes the younger members feel safe.
INFJ>ESTJ.tip: After you say something plainly, add, "Let me know if anything comes up." They'll find it easier to come to you, and you'll worry less at night.
INFJ>ESTJ.hidden: You move things forward with facts and planning, but you were also born good at imagining what's ahead. On your commute, don't you sometimes think, "It'd be great if we could do this in a few years"? Share that with your team, and it'll get them excited too.
INFJ>ESTJ.hidden_s: You move things forward with facts and planning, but you were also born good at imagining what's ahead. On your way to school, don't you sometimes think, "It'd be great if we could do this in a few years"? Share that with your club or class, and it'll get them excited too.

INFJ>ESFJ.title: At get-togethers, you check that everyone's having fun.
INFJ>ESFJ.body: At get-togethers, you notice right away when someone seems down. When someone's drink is about to run out, you ask, "Want to order something?" before they say anything. After being active among people, you need time alone to rest.
INFJ>ESFJ.say: "You seem a little down. Want to grab tea on the way home?"
INFJ>ESFJ.do: When an older neighbor is carrying something heavy, you carry it to their door.
INFJ>ESFJ.worry: You want to see people happy, so you do too much, and once you're alone you're suddenly exhausted. You don't want to ruin the mood, so sometimes you can't say what you want to.
INFJ>ESFJ.karai: Planning seats for a dinner, you spend ages deciding who sits next to whom.
INFJ>ESFJ.karai_s: Planning seats for a class party, you spend ages deciding who sits next to whom.
INFJ>ESFJ.aru: You invite the new person to lunch and show them the ropes so they don't feel left out. Your own work falls behind, and you end up staying late.
INFJ>ESFJ.aru_s: You invite the new kid to lunch and show them how things work so they don't feel left out. Your own homework falls behind, and you end up up late finishing it.
INFJ>ESFJ.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone and thinks about what things mean. As you gained experience, you became able to move among people and notice problems in front of you right away. Valuing people's feelings has been the same since way back. You can clearly see the new person's worries right in front of you, so you put them before your own work, and in the end you have to stay late.
INFJ>ESFJ.why_s: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone and thinks about what things mean. As you grew up, you became able to move among people and notice problems in front of you right away. Valuing people's feelings has been the same since way back. You can clearly see the new student's worries right in front of you, so you put them before your own assignments, and in the end you're up working on them until late at night.
INFJ>ESFJ.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and hunches or facts. Picture yourself busy at a get-together or picture yourself alone thinking about the future, and your result can change.
INFJ>ESFJ.plus: You keep going until you're worn out because you want everyone to have a good time. At a get-together with you there, even the people on the edges feel comfortable.
INFJ>ESFJ.tip: Decide ahead how long you'll help others, like "just 30 minutes at lunch." Your own work gets done too, so you can be kind without feeling rushed.
INFJ>ESFJ.tip_s: Decide ahead how long you'll help others, like "just during lunch." Your own homework gets done too, so you can be kind without feeling rushed.
INFJ>ESFJ.hidden: You quickly notice when someone needs help right now, but you were also born good at imagining what's ahead. While listening to a friend, don't you sometimes think, "This kind of job would suit them"? Tell them, and it'll give them a real lift.

INFJ>ISTP.title: You don't say much, but you jump in when someone needs help.
INFJ>ISTP.body: When you help someone move, you carry the heavy furniture without saying much. If a shelf is wobbly, you get out your tools and tighten the screws without a word. You show how you feel by working with your hands more than with words.
INFJ>ISTP.body_s: During school festival prep, you carry the heavy desks without saying much. If a sign is tilted, you tape it back in place without a word. You show how you feel by working with your hands more than with words.
INFJ>ISTP.say: "I focus better alone, so I'll get started on it."
INFJ>ISTP.do: On your day off, you build a plastic model kit alone and the whole day is gone.
INFJ>ISTP.worry: You show care through actions more than words, so sometimes your kindness doesn't come across. You can't tell if you want to think hard about the future or just do what you can right now.
INFJ>ISTP.karai: You say "I like being alone," but you read every message in the group chat.
INFJ>ISTP.aru: When a coworker's computer acts up, you go over and fix it right away. But a simple "Are you okay?" is hard to get out.
INFJ>ISTP.aru_s: When a friend's phone acts up, you ask to see it and fix it right away. But a simple "Are you okay?" is hard to get out.
INFJ>ISTP.why: By birth, you're the type who imagines what's ahead, decides with your feelings, and wants things to go as planned. As you gained experience, you became able to handle problems in front of you with logic and get to work with your hands right away. Your worry for others is still as it was when you were born. Even when you're worried, you think fixing the problem is the fastest way to help, so your hands get moving but a simple "Are you okay?" gets put off.
INFJ>ISTP.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself fixing something or picture yourself thinking about someone you care about, and a different type may come up.
INFJ>ISTP.plus: Your hands move before your words because you want to fix their problem fast. Quiet help like that gets noticed later.
INFJ>ISTP.tip: After you help, add just one line: "Does that look okay now?" That alone shows you care.
INFJ>ISTP.hidden: You're good at acting on the spot, but you were also born good at thinking ahead and putting things in order. The night before a day off, don't you think, "Tomorrow I'll do this, then that"? Use that, and you'll be trusted with bigger work.
INFJ>ISTP.hidden_s: You're good at acting on the spot, but you were also born good at thinking ahead and putting things in order. The night before a day off, don't you think, "Tomorrow I'll do this, then that"? Use that, and you'll be trusted with bigger roles.

INFJ>ISFP.title: You show your feelings with small gifts.
INFJ>ISFP.body: Feelings you can't put into words, you turn into a small present and give. When you find a handkerchief in a color a friend would like, you buy it even if it isn't their birthday. You think about the future too, but you often act on how you feel right now.
INFJ>ISFP.say: "This felt so you, I had to buy it."
INFJ>ISFP.do: When a friend is down, you buy their favorite snack and hand it over: "You like these, right?"
INFJ>ISFP.worry: You know you should think about the future, but you want to honor how you feel right now, so you can't decide. Sad news can bring you down for a whole day.
INFJ>ISFP.karai: After a party you couldn't say no to, you get home and can't get off the couch.
INFJ>ISFP.karai_s: After a hangout you couldn't say no to, you get home and can't get off the couch.
INFJ>ISFP.aru: You think, "I really need to think about my future," but your day off ends with a tour of your favorite gift shops. On the way home, you think, "Didn't get to it again."
INFJ>ISFP.why: By birth, you're the type who thinks ahead and wants things to go as planned. Through all kinds of experiences, you came to value what's in front of you and how you feel now, and to go with the moment. Your wish to think about your future is still very much there. On your days off, your heart turns to the things you love that are right in front of you, so the day ends while you're going around gift shops, and you remember your future on the way home.
INFJ>ISFP.yure: The two differences are hunches or facts, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture your future plans or picture today's fun, and your result can change.
INFJ>ISFP.plus: You lose track of time in gift shops because you can see what's good about the things in front of you. That's also why you're so good at picking gifts.
INFJ>ISFP.tip: Set a time for the future, like "30 minutes at a café once a month." The rest of your days off, you can just enjoy them.
INFJ>ISFP.hidden: You often go with your mood, but you were born good at making plans and getting ready. Before a trip, don't you look up the shops you want to visit ahead of time? Use that, and you can keep doing the things you love for a long time.

INFJ>ESTP.title: When the idea hits, you're already out the door.
INFJ>ESTP.body: You headed out on a sudden whim, yet on the way home you're carefully listening to a friend's worries. On a day off, you text someone, "Can you go now?" and an hour later you're already out. During the day you move fast, but at night you think about the day alone.
INFJ>ESTP.say: "Since we're out anyway, let's hit one more place on the way home."
INFJ>ESTP.say_s: "Since we're out anyway, let's check out one more spot on the way home."
INFJ>ESTP.do: When you get lost on a trip, you ask a local for directions and get a restaurant tip while you're at it.
INFJ>ESTP.worry: Being with everyone is fun, but when you get home you're suddenly exhausted. People sometimes see you as easygoing, so it can be hard for them to see how much you actually think.
INFJ>ESTP.karai: You were listening to a friend vent, and now you're angrier than they are.
INFJ>ESTP.aru: New restaurants, new activities, you're the first to say "Let's go!" But alone at night, something someone said that afternoon keeps bugging you.
INFJ>ESTP.why: All four letters are different. By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone, values what things mean and how people feel, and wants things to go as planned. As you gained experience, you started getting energy from being with people too, deciding quickly about what's in front of you, and acting on the spot. During the day you can move quickly among people, but when you're alone at night, your natural habit of mulling things over comes out, and you keep thinking about what a single comment from that afternoon meant.
INFJ>ESTP.yure: All four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself out having fun or picture yourself alone at night thinking, and you might get a totally different type.
INFJ>ESTP.plus: You go back over what people said because you don't take their words lightly. Someone who's fun and also thinks things through is someone people rely on.
INFJ>ESTP.tip: On nights when a comment won't leave your head, decide "I'll think about it tomorrow morning" and go to sleep. By morning, it usually bothers you less than you expected.
INFJ>ESTP.hidden: You often say "Let's just go," but you were born good at thinking ahead and getting ready. The night before an outing, don't you quietly look up the train home? Use that, and people will feel safe being around you.

INFJ>ESFP.title: After getting everyone going, you wonder, "Did everyone have fun?"
INFJ>ESFP.body: You were the most excited one at the party, yet on the way home you're wondering, "Did she have a good time?" When things start to get quiet, you quickly put on the next song or get someone talking. You love getting fired up with everyone, but you also need time alone to rest.
INFJ>ESFP.say: "Today's so much fun! Hey, let's ask the others to join us too."
INFJ>ESFP.do: When a friend gets a haircut, you notice right away and say, "It looks great!"
INFJ>ESFP.worry: After going all out having fun, you can't recover without time alone. You want to enjoy right now, but the future is on your mind a little too.
INFJ>ESFP.karai: At a sad movie, you cry because your friend next to you is crying.
INFJ>ESFP.aru: At karaoke you're the one getting everyone going, singing loud. But when you get home, you flop onto the couch and can't move for a while.
INFJ>ESFP.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone, thinks about what things mean, and wants things to go as planned. As the years went by, you started getting energy from being with people too, enjoying the moment, and going with the flow. Still, where you can store up energy is time alone, even now. At karaoke you use up your voice and all your attention so everyone has fun, so when you get home, you can't get up off the couch.
INFJ>ESFP.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change each time. Picture yourself out having fun or picture a quiet night alone, and a different type may come up.
INFJ>ESFP.plus: You can't move on the couch because you were giving it everything for everyone. When you're there, the whole get-together feels brighter.
INFJ>ESFP.tip: After a fun day out, keep the next morning as "do-nothing time." Set out your loungewear before you leave so you can rest as soon as you're back.
INFJ>ESFP.hidden: You're great at enjoying the moment, but you were also born good at picturing what's ahead. Don't you sometimes think, "Next year I'd like to try this"? Try telling a friend about it, and it can be what gets you to actually do it.

INFP>INTJ.title: Someone who's always thinking about something.
INFP>INTJ.body: When you get hooked on a favorite drama, you look up even the small details of the story, and you spend more time looking things up than watching. You summarize what you found in a notebook and even make a chart of how the characters are connected. Once you've decided what you want to do, you set the order and move ahead.
INFP>INTJ.say: "I know what I want to do. Now I just need to figure out the order."
INFP>INTJ.do: When you decide to redo your room, you save photos of rooms you like and even measure your furniture.
INFP>INTJ.worry: The more efficiently things go, the more you stop and ask, "Is this actually fun?" Even for things you want to choose by feel, you end up looking for reasons.
INFP>INTJ.karai: Once you start thinking, you sometimes miss your stop.
INFP>INTJ.aru: You're just picking a café, but you spend 30 minutes comparing reviews and prices. And in the end you pick it because "I just like this one."
INFP>INTJ.why: By birth, you're the type who's honest with your feelings and enjoys going with the flow. As you gained experience, you became able to compare with logic, decide what's next, and move forward. Sensing what you like and dislike through your feelings hasn't changed. Comparing reviews and prices is how you think now, but what settles it in the end is the feeling you were born with, so you end up choosing because "I just like this one."
INFP>INTJ.yure: The two differences are logic or feelings, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture yourself planning work or picture yourself doing something you love, and your result can change.
INFP>INTJ.yure_s: The two differences are logic or feelings, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture yourself planning out homework or prep or picture yourself doing something you love, and your result can change.
INFP>INTJ.plus: You can choose by "I like it" in the end because efficiency alone doesn't satisfy you. You look things up well before you choose, so you take good care of what you pick for a long time.
INFP>INTJ.tip: When you're choosing something you like, try a rule: "Ten minutes of research, max." You'll pick by feel in the end anyway, so you can decide before you're worn out.
INFP>INTJ.hidden: You're good at sticking to the plan, but you were also born able to enjoy the moment. On a trip, don't you sometimes want to wander down a street that wasn't on the plan? Use that, and you can enjoy it instead of panicking when plans change.

INFP>INTP.title: When something makes you cry, you want to know why.
INFP>INTP.body: When the talk turns to a favorite manga, you can't stop, and you want to explain the reasons behind "this part is great." With songs you love, you read the lyrics again and again to pin down where they moved you. You value people's feelings, but you also like thinking things through with logic.
INFP>INTP.say: "I wonder how far space actually goes."
INFP>INTP.do: You start looking up where a word comes from and are still reading at midnight.
INFP>INTP.worry: If you can't explain what you felt with logic, you can't settle down. Sometimes you think so much that you can't just enjoy things.
INFP>INTP.karai: While deciding what to do on your day off, you're still in bed and it's evening.
INFP>INTP.aru: After a movie with a friend, they say "That was good" and leave it there, but you spend the whole way home talking about why it made you cry.
INFP>INTP.why: By birth, you're the type who decides with your feelings. Through all kinds of experiences, you started thinking with logic and wanting to know how things work. Being easily moved is the same as ever. Being moved turns into a question, "Why is that?", so even after a movie, you can't stop talking until you know why it made you cry.
INFP>INTP.yure: The only difference is logic or feelings. Picture yourself researching something and you lean toward logic. Picture yourself watching something you love and you lean toward feelings.
INFP>INTP.plus: You want to know why something moved you because that feeling matters to you. You can put what you felt into words, so your thoughts on things are fun to hear.
INFP>INTP.tip: With movies or music, try enjoying them the first time without thinking, and thinking about them the second time. That way you don't lose either kind of fun.
INFP>INTP.hidden: You're good at thinking with logic, but you were also born good at noticing how people feel. When a friend is down, don't you sometimes say "That sounds really hard" before giving any advice? That one line makes it easier for them to keep talking.

INFP>ENTJ.title: You set the goal and lead the way.
INFP>ENTJ.body: In meetings you state the goal clearly and also explain why you like the idea. For whatever was decided, you put together who's in charge and the deadlines that same day and send them to everyone. You're good at standing in front of people and making decisions, but time alone doing what you love matters to you too.
INFP>ENTJ.body_s: In discussions you state the goal clearly and also explain why you like the idea. For whatever was decided, you put together who's in charge and the deadlines that same day and send them to the group chat. You're good at standing in front of people and making decisions, but time alone doing what you love matters to you too.
INFP>ENTJ.say: "Let's finish it this month. I really like this project."
INFP>ENTJ.do: While helping a junior with a problem, you break it down for them: "First this, then this."
INFP>ENTJ.worry: The more you lead, the less time you have alone for what you love. On days you make a strict call, you keep wondering, "Was that right?"
INFP>ENTJ.karai: You were talking about this trip, and somehow you've already picked the next one.
INFP>ENTJ.aru: At work you decide things quickly and people rely on you. But at home, if you don't get time to zone out to your favorite music, you can't recharge.
INFP>ENTJ.aru_s: In your club or class you decide things quickly and people rely on you. But at home, if you don't get time to zone out to your favorite music, you can't recharge.
INFP>ENTJ.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone, decides with your feelings, and goes with the flow. Through dealing with all kinds of people, you became able to stand in front of others, decide with logic, and see things through. Even so, the way you recharge is still as it was when you were born. Out in the world you take on the role of deciding and use up energy, so unless you zone out at home listening to your favorite music, your energy for the next day won't build back up.
INFP>ENTJ.yure: Three of the four are different, so your result can change a lot. Picture yourself leading a team or picture yourself lost in something you love, and a different type may come up.
INFP>ENTJ.plus: You think it over afterward because your own feelings matter to you. People follow a leader who talks about what they love, not just the goal.
INFP>ENTJ.tip: On days you make a strict call, decide to listen to one favorite song on the way home. If you're worried about how you came across to someone, a simple "Thanks for yesterday" the next day is enough.
INFP>ENTJ.hidden: You decide things firmly and move forward, but you were also born able to enjoy going with the flow. Have you ever gone out on a day off with no plan and found a great shop by chance? Use that, and you can stay calm when things don't go as planned.

INFP>ENTP.title: You say exactly what you think, then worry about it later.
INFP>ENTP.body: Right after you say, "Wouldn't it be fun to flip it around?", you quietly glance at the other person's face. You like adding a different angle to a friend's story, "You could see it this way too," and growing the conversation. You like talking with people, but you also need time alone to think.
INFP>ENTP.say: "Wait, what you just said gave me an idea."
INFP>ENTP.do: You and a friend get excited, "That would be a hit as a video!", and you keep thinking up ideas after you get home.
INFP>ENTP.worry: You come up with lots of ideas but can't narrow them down to one. You never seem to get enough time with people or enough time alone.
INFP>ENTP.karai: Every new hobby: buy all the gear, then move on to the next.
INFP>ENTP.aru: The conversation gets fun and you tease a friend a little too hard. That night in bed you think, "Did I hurt them?" and keep typing and deleting a sorry message.
INFP>ENTP.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone and decides with your feelings. As you gained experience, you became able to expand your ideas by talking with people and dig into them with logic. Being sensitive to other people's feelings is something you were born with. While you're talking, going back and forth is fun and you can say things strongly, but once you're in bed you suddenly worry about how they took it, and you keep typing and deleting an apology text.
INFP>ENTP.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and logic or feelings. Picture yourself having fun with friends or picture yourself lost in thought alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ENTP.plus: You remember it at night because the other person matters more to you than winning. Someone who says fun things and checks in afterward is easy to talk to.
INFP>ENTP.tip: When you say something sharp, add with a laugh right then, "I'm just throwing out ideas." Saying it on the spot is much easier than worrying all night.
INFP>ENTP.hidden: You're good at growing ideas by talking with people, but you were also born good at imagining deeply on your own. When you're listening to music alone, don't stories and ideas sometimes come one after another? Protect that time, and your ideas will be easier to turn into something real.

INFP>INFJ.title: You start things on a whim and keep at them.
INFP>INFJ.body: It's a hobby you started on a whim, yet before you know it you've even set a practice schedule. You write time for the things you love into your calendar first. You like acting on your mood, but thinking ahead and preparing puts you at ease.
INFP>INFJ.say: "This view feels kind of nostalgic somehow."
INFP>INFJ.do: At night, you turn off the lights and play your favorite song over and over by yourself.
INFP>INFJ.worry: You want to stay free, but you also want things settled, so you keep adding plans and deleting them. Trying to meet people's expectations, you sometimes put your own feelings last.
INFP>INFJ.karai: Even after the movie credits end, you can't quite get up from your seat.
INFP>INFJ.aru: It was an exhibit you'd go to "if you felt like it," but days ahead you've already got the ticket and your outfit ready.
INFP>INFJ.why: By birth, you're the type who wants to move wherever your mood takes you. As you gained experience, you became able to think ahead and prepare. Thinking lightly, "if I feel like it," is how you naturally feel things. The more you're looking forward to something, the less you want to rush on the day and the more you want to finish preparing first, so your ticket and outfit are ready days in advance.
INFP>INFJ.yure: The only difference is sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture plans with other people and you lean toward planning. Picture a day off alone and you lean toward going with the flow.
INFP>INFJ.plus: You add and delete plans because you're looking for what works for you. You can get ready ahead of time, so you actually do what you want to do.
INFP>INFJ.tip: For invites you're unsure about, ask early on, "Is it okay if I decide on the day?" Once you know it's okay to skip, you won't over-prepare.
INFP>INFJ.hidden: You get well prepared before you act, but you were also born light on your feet. On the way home, don't you sometimes want to take a different street just because? Use that, and you can enjoy it when plans suddenly change.

INFP>INFP.title: You hold on to the things you "just like."
INFP>INFP.body: When you find a little item you love, you can't move away from it for a while. In your room, letters you got years ago and small ornaments are still on display. You feel free in a room surrounded by things you love, but in places where you're chasing quotas, you tend to lose your energy.
INFP>INFP.say: "That's so lovely. ...I can't really explain it, but it's just nice, you know?"
INFP>INFP.do: When you see a pretty sunset on the way home, you stop and look.
INFP>INFP.worry: If you keep doing things that don't fit how you feel, you lose energy without knowing why. The harder you try to fit in, the more you forget what you used to like.
INFP>INFP.karai: In your head you've gone on trip after trip, but on your actual days off you barely leave the house.
INFP>INFP.aru: When you think "I just like this," you can't let it go even if you can't say why. When someone asks "What's so good about it?", all you can say is "I don't know, I just do."
INFP>INFP.why: Your temperament and character are the same combination in all four letters. Treasuring the things you love and resting your feelings with time alone has carried on just as it is since you were a kid. Likes and dislikes are decided by feeling before any reason. "I like it" is settled in your heart before it turns into words, so when someone asks what's good about it, you can't explain it well.
INFP>INFP.yure: Your temperament and character are the same, so you tend to get similar results every time. If a different type shows up, you may be going through a stretch of fitting in with others and putting your own likes last.
INFP>INFP.plus: You can love things without a reason because you trust how you feel. Even if you can't explain it well, that "this is nice" is worth holding on to.
INFP>INFP.tip: When someone asks "What's so good about it?", name just one thing you like. Even "I like the color" gets it across.
INFP>INFP.hidden: You also have the ability to think things through with logic. You may just not have had many chances to use it yet. While looking up something you love, haven't you suddenly realized, "Oh, that's why I like it"? Use that, and it'll be easier to share what you love with others.

INFP>ENFJ.title: You gather friends to make your ideas happen.
INFP>ENFJ.body: You think up a small event and call your friends together. You write the day's flow on paper and ask each person to take a role they can handle. You like leading everyone, but without time alone, you wear out.
INFP>ENFJ.say: "If we all do it, we've got this! I already made the schedule."
INFP>ENFJ.do: When a friend is down, you say "Let's get dinner soon" and send a few possible dates.
INFP>ENFJ.worry: While cheering others on, you lose your time alone to rest. The more you plan around everyone, the less free you feel.
INFP>ENFJ.karai: You cheer on everyone's dreams with all you've got, but when it's your dream, your voice gets quiet.
INFP>ENFJ.aru: At events with friends you lead everyone and hear "You're so dependable." But afterward, you can't settle down until you put in earbuds and play your favorite song.
INFP>ENFJ.aru_s: At your club's event you lead everyone and hear "You're so dependable." But afterward, you can't settle down until you put in earbuds and play your favorite song.
INFP>ENFJ.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone and moves wherever your mood takes you. Through dealing with all kinds of people, you became able to lead among others, decide what's next, and move forward. The place where your heart settles is still your own world. The whole time you're in front of people, you're looking out for everyone, so afterward you can't settle down until you go back to your own world with a favorite song.
INFP>ENFJ.yure: The two differences are whether people energize you or you recharge alone, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture yourself running an event or picture yourself resting alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ENFJ.plus: You want time alone to rest because you worked that hard for everyone. Once you've rested, you can cheer everyone up again.
INFP>ENFJ.tip: When you plan for everyone, pick your own rest day first and tell them, "I can't do that day." If you say it early, you'll actually get to rest.
INFP>ENFJ.hidden: You plan ahead and bring people together, but you were also born free to follow your mood. On a day with no plans, don't you want to just get on a train without picking a place? Use that, and you can laugh and start over when plans fall apart.

INFP>ENFP.title: You replay the fun days alone at night.
INFP>ENFP.body: On the night of a day you made everyone laugh in a lively place, you think back on it alone and enjoy it all over again. When a friend invites you, you jump right in with "Sounds great!" even if it's a place you've never been. Meeting people gives you energy, but you love time alone just as much.
INFP>ENFP.say: "Hey, listen! I just had the best dream."
INFP>ENFP.do: When you go out, you make friends with strangers too and end up taking photos together.
INFP>ENFP.worry: You love seeing people, but if you see them too much, you suddenly don't want to talk to anyone. You can't tell when it'll happen yourself, and you feel bad after turning down plans.
INFP>ENFP.karai: Once your favorite manga comes up, you can't stop, and you're the only one talking.
INFP>ENFP.aru: You were having fun at the party until the very end, but on the train home you put in earbuds and slip into your own world.
INFP>ENFP.aru_s: You were having fun at the after-party until the very end, but on the train home you put in earbuds and slip into your own world.
INFP>ENFP.why: By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone. Through all kinds of experiences, you also started getting energy from meeting people. You can stay excited until the very end at a fun event, but the place where your feelings settle is still time alone. You put in earbuds on the train home to savor the fun day again on your own and bring your feelings back to normal.
INFP>ENFP.yure: The only difference is whether people energize you or you recharge alone. Take it after a day out with friends or after a day off alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ENFP.plus: Having days you don't want to see anyone means you want your time with people to be good. After a rest, you're back to making everyone laugh.
INFP>ENFP.tip: Try a limit of two social plans a week, and you'll have fewer days where you suddenly crash. When you say no, just be honest: "I want to see you when I've got energy." Most people will get it.
INFP>ENFP.hidden: You get close to anyone fast, but you were born good at slowly thinking about your own feelings alone. On a walk by yourself, don't you sometimes realize, "This is what matters to me"? Use that, and you can choose your own path at school or work without being swept along.

INFP>ISTJ.title: Whatever you're asked to do, you finish it with care.
INFP>ISTJ.body: You finish the documents you're asked for properly, and you're secretly particular about the colors and fonts too. You turn them in several days before the deadline and even leave time to look them over. You do your work seriously, but in your heart you're thinking about what you want to do.
INFP>ISTJ.body_s: You finish your assignments properly, and you're secretly particular about the colors and fonts too. You turn them in several days before the deadline and even leave time to look them over. You take your classes and assignments seriously, but in your heart you're thinking about what you want to do.
INFP>ISTJ.say: "I'm heading out on time today. See you tomorrow."
INFP>ISTJ.say_s: "I'm heading out now. See you tomorrow."
INFP>ISTJ.do: The day before you go somewhere, you double-check what to bring and what time to leave.
INFP>ISTJ.worry: You get everything done properly, yet sometimes you think, "Is this what I wanted to do?" Even when starting something you love, you want a reason and a plan first.
INFP>ISTJ.karai: You smile at the work party, but inside you keep thinking, "I want to go home."
INFP>ISTJ.karai_s: You smile at the class party, but inside you keep thinking, "I want to go home."
INFP>ISTJ.aru: At work people call you "so organized." But at home, you watch your favorite movie and cry by yourself.
INFP>ISTJ.aru_s: At school people call you "so organized." But at home, you watch your favorite movie and cry by yourself.
INFP>ISTJ.why: By birth, you're the type who imagines new things, decides with your feelings, and moves wherever your mood takes you. As you gained experience, you became able to stick to how things have been done, decide with logic, and finish things on schedule. Being easily moved is still as it was when you were born. At work you carry out what's been decided properly, so there are few chances to show your feelings, and when you watch a movie at home, the feelings you've been holding in come out as tears.

INFP>ISTJ.hidden: You do what's asked of you accurately, but you were also born good at imagining what doesn't exist yet. Between tasks, don't you sometimes think, "It'd be fun if there were a shop like this"? Say those ideas out loud, and people will see how interesting you are.

INFP>ISFJ.title: You quietly do things for your family.
INFP>ISFJ.body: You secretly add one of your family's favorite dishes to the packed lunch. You keep trash day and your family's plans in your head without looking at the calendar. While going through each day properly, you hold small dreams in your heart.
INFP>ISFJ.body_s: On days your family seems busy, you fold the laundry before anyone asks. On a friend's birthday, you remember their favorite snack and give it to them. While going through each day properly, you hold small dreams in your heart.
INFP>ISFJ.do: When someone in your family has a fever, you make rice porridge without a word and bring it to them.
INFP>ISFJ.worry: With days full of routine tasks, your time for what you love keeps shrinking. You're glad to be useful, but sometimes you wonder, "What did I want to do again?"
INFP>ISFJ.karai: Even when the wrong dish comes, you eat it because you feel bad for the server.
INFP>ISFJ.aru: You remember family birthdays, trash day, and your friends' favorite foods. But your own "someday I want to..." hasn't moved in years.
INFP>ISFJ.aru_s: You remember family birthdays, homework deadlines, and your friends' favorite foods. But your own "someday I want to..." still hasn't moved.
INFP>ISFJ.why: By birth, you're the type who imagines new things and moves wherever your mood takes you. As the years went by, you became able to run each day properly and on schedule, based on what's happened before. Your wish to picture your dreams hasn't gone away. Your daily schedule fills up first with things for your family and other people, so years can go by without you finding time to start what you want to do.
INFP>ISFJ.yure: The two differences are hunches or facts, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture daily chores and work or picture yourself daydreaming alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ISFJ.yure_s: The two differences are hunches or facts, and sticking to a plan or going with the flow. Picture your everyday classes and helping out at home or picture yourself daydreaming alone, and your result can change.
INFP>ISFJ.plus: You remember so much about people because you care about them. Turn a bit of that care toward your own dream, and it will start moving.
INFP>ISFJ.tip: Pick one "day for what I love" each month and tell your family ahead of time. When everyone knows about it, it's harder to push aside.
INFP>ISFJ.hidden: You keep every day running smoothly, but you were also born light on your feet. Don't you sometimes plan dinner, then see fresh vegetables at the store and think, "Let's make this tonight instead"? Use that, and you'll start enjoying the unplanned moments.
INFP>ISFJ.hidden_s: You keep every day running smoothly, but you were also born light on your feet. Don't you sometimes decide where to stop on the way home, then see a new place your friend found and think, "Let's go there today instead"? Use that, and you'll start enjoying the unplanned moments.

INFP>ESTJ.title_s: Brisk at school, relaxing alone at home.
INFP>ESTJ.body: At work you briskly tell people "do it this way," and at home you lose yourself alone in favorite music and books. You come across quite differently at work and at home. Time spent moving things along in an organized way and quiet time alone both matter to you.
INFP>ESTJ.body_s: In clubs and on committees you briskly tell people "do it this way," and at home you lose yourself alone in favorite music and books. You come across quite differently at school and at home. Time spent moving things along in an organized way and quiet time alone both matter to you.
INFP>ESTJ.say: "That's it for today! Everyone getting enough rest?"
INFP>ESTJ.do: On moving day, you tell everyone what order to carry things in, and hand out juice to whoever looks tired.
INFP>ESTJ.do_s: On school festival prep day, you tell everyone what order to carry things in, and hand out juice to whoever looks tired.
INFP>ESTJ.worry: The more people rely on you to lead, the more your own feelings come last. On days you were strict, you keep replaying the moment after you get home.
INFP>ESTJ.karai: The one who said "Just get there on time, no rush" has been waiting since 15 minutes early.
INFP>ESTJ.aru: In meetings you keep things moving: "Please have this done by this date." But on the train home you think, "Was I a little strict today?"
INFP>ESTJ.aru_s: At student council meetings you keep things moving: "Please have this done by this date." But on the train home you think, "Was I a little strict today?"
INFP>ESTJ.why: All four letters are different. By birth, you're the type who recharges by resting alone, imagines new things, decides with your feelings, and moves wherever your mood takes you. As you gained experience, you became able to bring people together, decide based on how things have been done and on logic, and keep things on schedule. In meetings you think it's your job to keep things moving, so you can say it clearly, but once you're alone, your care for people comes back and you replay how you said things again and again.
